justification: Read `src/main/java/org/jsoup/parser/TreeBuilder.java`, `Parser.java`, `StreamParser.java`, `HtmlTreeBuilder.java`, `XmlTreeBuilder.java`, `Token.java`, and the repo-wide `rg` results. `TreeBuilder` has wide fan-out: it directly imports/touches `Validate`, `SharedConstants`, `Attributes`, `Document`, `Element`, `Node`, `Range`, `NodeVisitor`, `CharacterReader`, `Tokeniser`, `Token`, `ParseSettings`, `TagSet`, `ParseErrorList`, and `ParseError` (`TreeBuilder.java:3-15, 40-59, 101-185`). It also has strong fan-in: 11 other files reference it, including both concrete builders and core parser classes (`HtmlTreeBuilder.java:29`, `XmlTreeBuilder.java:37`, `Parser.java:27, 39-43, 91, 121, 132`, `StreamParser.java:58-71, 83-108`, `Token.java:110-117`, plus `HtmlTreeBuilderState` and 4 tests). That concentration of shared dependencies makes `TreeBuilder` a dependency hub.
